narrative.northStar: A considered South African home-fragrance object
narrative.overview: Approved visual authority is Figma file jIMvwSBkilg7eplo3IiHPa, page 2004:14, section 2484:736 and contracts 2484:737. Retain existing foundations. INF-33 Shop/Product and INF-34 Home/shared-shell/Cart are merged. PR74 at d6c2018 delivers combined About, Guide preferences and corrected primary button labels, with Devon's desktop/tablet/mobile approval and production smoke evidence. User-approved About viewport sizing supersedes the initial Figma full-column size. App and Storybook share actual Marcellus/Manrope fonts. Guide matching and source publication remain gated. Approved Contact under INF-27 uses centered hero text over Shop's placeholder image, centered direct-email content and full-width writing guidance on Home's gold invitation surface with the approved midnight shell. Devon approved frames 2529:2/19/37/55 on 9 September; they are promoted to Approved and implemented in runtime/Storybook under INF-35. See docs/features/inf-27-contact.md. Devon approved Guide note/character matching on 9 September. Frames 2172:2 and 2457:601/749/897 with contract 2458:676 are synchronized. Results use source-derived reasons, 1-3 actual matches, explicit equal editorial ranking and unavailable states. Other four answers are summary-only. Existing tokens reused; Sanity publication remains deferred with an accepted versioned repository snapshot. Devon subsequently requested Suggested fragrances before Your fragrance preferences. Continue focuses suggestions when available and preferences for empty/failure states; existing section styles remain.
keyCharacteristics: Marcellus display and Manrope interface typography

rules.name: Current design authority
rules.body: Use DESIGN.md and docs/features/2026-09-08-design-approval.md. Historical links do not override the current Approved frames.

rules.name: Shop and product contract
rules.body: Light cards use porcelain-0, 20px display titles, 12px metadata, 15px prices and 145% line height. Product headings use 115% line height. The collection hero scrim is #191916 at 54%. Preserve growing panels and source-owned purchase states.

rules.name: Home and shared shell
rules.body: Retain all Home sections. Quiet surfaces use sage-100; invitation uses gold-300. Footer links are frame-centered on desktop and left-aligned in mobile columns below a centered logo. Plain hero and failure frames use5:4; square quantity controls retain44px targets.

rules.name: About and Guide contract
rules.body: About uses stable source gallery IDs, image-only 3:4 campaign figures capped at available viewport height minus 128px for the header and breathing room with contain fitting per Devon's refinement and captioned 16:9/4:3 market figures. Guide answer surface #F7F3EA, border rgb(132 101 35 / 55%), number ink #846523 map to semantic roles. Verify actual loaded fonts before screenshots. Primary button material must stay behind all label content, including plain-text links. Guide sample rankings remain Storybook-only.

rules.name: Editorial carousel and floating navigation
rules.body: 12 September approved Figma composition 2664:2 and mobile 2674:22: 64px header, uppercase Manrope, close underline, 44px account/bag/menu controls, transparent Home header until scrollY > 24 then midnight. Shared reed-shadow background; manual synchronized title/subtitle/CTA/image slides, 520/600 desktop columns, 5:4 media, mobile stack. Preserve existing tokens and conditional commerce links. See docs/features/carousel-navigation.md. Follow-up: share the site-wide max-1440 container, 20/24/40/64px gutters and minimum 100svh hero height; vertically center and grow for long content. Next translates right-to-left and Previous reverses, 600ms ease-in-out without fading; reduced motion is instant. Desktop arrows use outer-gutter midpoints. Scrolled header has a 1px navigation-divider rule without height change.

rules.name: Consolidated delivery
rules.body: PR #83 includes current component governance and interim Contact enquiry defaults. Solid navigation retains its gold divider; floating Home navigation shows gold only after scroll. Mobile keyboard order follows visual order: home, account, cart, menu. Preserve INF-28/31 deferrals and human release gates. See docs/design-implementation.md.

rules.name: Navigation breathing room
rules.body: Shared --navigation-height is 80px desktop (1024px+) and 72px below. Existing logo sizes stay. Menu header and hero offset share the token; solid border is inside the height. Supersedes earlier 64px header.

rules.name: Carousel autoplay and laptop clearance
rules.body: 86px desktop / 78px mobile navigation. Editorial slides rotate every 6s with pause/play, manual/focus pause and hover/visibility protections. Reduced-motion/save-data/loading disable autoplay. Laptop 1024–1535px hero insets 96px leave 42px arrow clearance; mobile/wide gutters unchanged. Moving stage edges use a 24px alpha fade; stationary media is crisp.

rules.name: Carousel viewport fit
rules.body: Reserve navigation and counter room using viewport-aware media heights; desktop cap is 100svh minus navigation minus 136px. Narrow media clamps between 120px and 380px using 100svh minus 500px. Keep text and 44px targets; allow content extremes to scroll. Counter is 11px gold below the image, with no separate icon. Image border is 1px semantic gold. Phone headlines below 640px use 30px type and 36px line height. Phone descriptions use 15px/24px; CTA labels use 12px with unchanged 48px button height.

dos: Do verify changed components and consuming pages against exact approved frames at 1440, 768, 390 and 320 where supplied.
Do preserve source-owned content and existing commerce behavior.
donts: Do not infer visual fidelity from passing tests alone.
Do not turn static Guide examples into unverified recommendation claims.
